brief: Root cause for the recurring class: when an orchestrator session or its host stops, the programme stops silently. Instances: 2026-10-18 three cloud handoffs missed while the tick reported only changed refs; 2026-10-20 a session crash killed every loop and lost the ledger from 07:10Z to 13:20Z; 2026-10-21 a host restart killed the merge train, tick loop, state beat and wt_sync, leaving nine handoffs with no pull request (oldest 110 h), a blocked verdict unrouted for 8 h, ten merges unrecorded and the session ledger silent for 16 h, while the tick board had grown to 4.5 MB from replayed relay lines. Owed per root-cause.md: the named cause, the process state a-d with evidence, the class search, the cost test with numbers, and a countermeasure or recorded refusal. Three or more instances make this an audit class that owes a barrier (defect-root-cause.md). Scope it apart from R10-RCA-HANDOFF-SLIP (the orphaned-handoff record) and R10-TICK-OWED-LEVEL (the replay reader fix): cite them, do not redo them. Decision 0012 forbids a new policy file, lint class or rules entry until 2026-10-31; a countermeasure that is an instrument lands under tools/audit/seat with a self-test demonstrated failing on the defect and passing once fixed.
